instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Implement a pipelined module that performs the same functionality as the given prompt, but with a few changes. Create a 8-bit shift-left register with parallel load and synchronous reset. The module should have a clock input, a synchronous reset input, a parallel load input, a shift input, a 8-bit input, and a 8-bit output. When the shift input is high, the register should shift left on the rising edge of the clock signal. When the parallel load input is high, the register should load the input on the rising edge of the clock signal. The register should reset to zero on the rising edge of the reset signal. Use pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
